verses.text: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.

xrefs.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.

verses.text: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.

xrefs.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.

verses.text: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.

xrefs.text: Then the maidens will rejoice with dancing, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into joy, and give them comfort and joy for their sorrow.
So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD,
As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD, and she despised him in her heart.

verses.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

xrefs.text: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

verses.text: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.

xrefs.text: But no one asks, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives us songs in the night,
The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!

verses.text: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,

xrefs.text: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.

Then the Levites— Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah— said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting: Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

xrefs.text: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.
This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they opposed them on their way up from Egypt.
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
